chat: Isabella Rodriguez
Hi Eddy, it's Isabella from Hobbs Cafe. I hope you're doing well and enjoying your studies. Just wanted to confirm everything is set for your performance tonight at 5:00 pm.
Eddy Lin
Hi Isabella, thanks for checking in. I'm looking forward to it and will make sure everything is ready on time. Do you have any specific song suggestions or themes you'd like me to consider?
Isabella Rodriguez

I was thinking it would be lovely if you could play something romantic and soothing. Maybe some classics or original pieces that evoke a cozy, intimate atmosphere for our Valentine’s Day guests. How does that sound?
Eddy Lin

Sounds great! I'll definitely aim for a relaxed and romantic atmosphere. Perhaps I could include some covers of well-known love songs along with my original compositions to give it that special touch.
Isabella Rodriguez
That sounds wonderful, Eddy. I'm really looking forward to seeing your performance tonight. Just let me know if you need anything from us before then.
Eddy Lin

Will do, Isabella. I’ll make sure to bring all necessary equipment and arrive a bit early to set everything up smoothly. And thank you for your support; it’s really helpful to have such an attentive organizer like yourself on board.
Isabella Rodriguez
That’s perfect, Eddy. If you need any assistance setting up or anything else at all, just let me know. I’ll be around to ensure everything goes smoothly tonight.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Isabella. I appreciate your help and flexibility. Let’s touch base just before my set to go over anything we might need to adjust or confirm.
Isabella Rodriguez
Sounds good, Eddy. Have a great day and I'll see you here around 4:30 pm to go over everything one last time before your performance.
Eddy Lin
Perfect, Isabella. I'll be there around 4:30 pm as well to finalize our plans and make sure everything runs smoothly. See you then!
Isabella Rodriguez
Great, Eddy. Have a productive day and I look forward to working together tonight.
Eddy Lin
Thanks again, Isabella. I'll make sure everything is perfect for tonight. Talk to you soon!
